user.title: Create a shared coffee pool
user.description: Everyone with access to this pool shares its balance, cup price and history. Negative balances are allowed so every coffee can be recorded. Currency cannot be changed later.

data_description.cup_price: A positive amount with up to two decimal places, for example 2.00.
data_description.opening_balance: The total money already in this pool.

error.invalid_amount: Enter valid amounts with up to two decimal places. Cup price must be between 0.01 and 10000.
error.invalid_name: Enter a pool name with 1–80 characters.
